clips.title: The story
paras: Alanndarian Nightsong is a night elf resident of Auberdine in Darkshore dedicated to tending to the region's beleaguered fauna. She works alongside travelers to remedy the blights plaguing the local wildlife, particularly the native striders and forest creatures corrupted by dark forces.

Situated in the coastal settlement of Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong watches over the fragile ecological balance of Darkshore. As mysterious taints seep into the soil and waters, the creatures of the ancient woods have begun to succumb to sickness and unnatural aggression. Alanndarian acts as a guardian and naturalist, seeking practical remedies to ease their suffering and restore their natural vigor.
